page.title: Time machine
page.sub: Replay a portfolio on frozen historical data, without rules and then with a strategy, side by side. Fictitious amount, no real order.
page.label: Illustrative replay on historical data. This is not a prediction.
page.askMessage: Explain replay {id} to me from its numbers only: what the strategy changed, the return, the worst fall and the volatility.

controls.title: Replay settings
controls.sub: Both series start from the same portfolio, the same amount and the same data.
controls.noStrategies: No saved strategy yet: the replay will run without rules.
controls.footnote: Signal at the close of a day, execution at the price of the next trading day.

states.errorGeneric: The replay could not be computed.
states.nothingTitle: None of this portfolio's holdings can be replayed
states.nothingHint: Pick another portfolio or a later start date. The snapshot's symbols are listed under “Why this data?”.

idle.title: How it works
idle.one: Pick a portfolio, a strategy (or no rules), a fictitious amount and a start date.
idle.two: The engine replays two series day by day on the frozen snapshot: the same portfolio held as is, and the same portfolio run by the strategy.
idle.three: You watch both curves being drawn, every rule firing, the order journal and a comparison in numbers, with no verdict.

ids.startMoved: Date asked: {asked}. The replay starts on the first available trading day, {from}.

chart.title: The two replays
chart.sub: Value in Canadian dollars. Drag on the chart or use the slider to travel back in time.
chart.aria: Simulated value from {from} to {to}, starting from {capital}: {without} without rules, {with} with the strategy.

event.title: Rule firing
event.before: Value at the close of the decision day
event.after: Value at the close of the execution day
event.beforeAfterNote: The gap between the two values comes mostly from prices moving between the two closes, plus fees if any.
event.orders: {count, plural, =0 {No order} one {# order} other {# orders}}
event.hint: Click a marker on the chart or a row of the journal to see one of the {count, plural, one {# firing} other {# firings}}.
event.none: No rule fired during this replay: the two series are identical.
event.noRules: Replay without rules: there is no firing to show.

describe.allocation_drift: Bring the {count, plural, one {# allocation target} other {# allocation targets}} back as soon as a gap exceeds {drift} points.

describe.weight_cap_to: No holding above {cap}%; the excess goes to {symbol}.

condition.guard_enter: Fall of {fall}% below the peak (threshold: {threshold}%): {value} against a peak of {peak}.
condition.guard_exit: Fall back to {fall}% (return threshold: {threshold}%): {value} against a peak of {peak}.
condition.rebalance_quarterly: Quarter {quarter}: the largest gap with the target was {drift} points ({symbol}).
condition.rebalance_drift: Gap of {drift} points with the target ({symbol}), threshold of {threshold} points.
condition.weight_cap: {symbol} weighed {weight}% (cap: {cap}%){others, plural, =0 {} one {, and # other holding above} other {, and # other holdings above}}.

journal.title: Order journal
journal.sub: The simulated orders of the series with the strategy, one sentence per order.
journal.count: {count, plural, =0 {No rule order} one {# rule order} other {# rule orders}}, plus {initial} starting orders.
journal.noRules: Replay without rules: only the starting orders are in the journal.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.sub: The same measures for both series. The difference is “with” minus “without”.
compare.note: The number of orders counts the rules' orders; the {initial} starting orders are common to both series. Time-weighted return, dividends reinvested. An empty 2022 return means the replay does not cover the whole year.
compare.contributionsNote: Returns are time-weighted: money added is not counted as a gain.

gap.title: Gap over time
gap.aria: Gap between the two series over time, in index points; final gap: {final}.
gap.note: “With the strategy” minus “without rules”, in index points (100 = starting amount).

summary.title: Neutral summary
summary.sub: Facts taken from the replay's numbers, with no verdict.
summary.noRules: Without rules, the two series are identical: the starting portfolio held as is.
summary.identical: The rules changed no holding: the two series are identical.
summary.endedEqual: Both series ended at the same total return.
summary.endedWith: The series with the strategy ended higher: {with} total return against {without}, {pts} points more.
summary.endedWithout: The series without rules ended higher: {without} total return against {with}, {pts} points more.
summary.fallShallower: The worst fall was {pts} points shallower with the strategy: {with} against {without}.
summary.fallDeeper: The worst fall was {pts} points deeper with the strategy: {with} against {without}.
summary.fallSame: The worst fall is the same in both series: {value}.
summary.volLower: Annualised volatility was {pts} points lower with the strategy: {with} against {without}.
summary.volHigher: Annualised volatility was {pts} points higher with the strategy: {with} against {without}.
summary.volSame: Annualised volatility is the same in both series: {with}.
summary.tradeoffCost: Over this period, the strategy cost return but reduced the worst fall: a trade-off between risk and return that each person weighs according to their own situation.
summary.tradeoffRisk: Over this period, the strategy ended higher, but with a deeper worst fall: the extra return came with more risk.
summary.fees: Fees differed by {cad} between the two series.
summary.contributions: The strategy added {cad} of periodic contributions; the returns and gaps above exclude them.
summary.valueGap: Final value gap, with minus without: {cad}.
summary.valueGapEx: Final value gap excluding contributions, with minus without: {cad}.

effects.title: Market effect and currency effect
effects.sub: Where each series' change in value came from.
effects.explain: The market effect is the change in prices in their listing currency; the currency effect is what the USD/CAD rate added or removed on U.S. assets and crypto.

contrib.title: Contribution of each rule
contrib.explain: What each rule changes on its own: the full strategy minus the same strategy without that rule. Contributions do not necessarily add up, since the rules interact.

caveats.title: Assumptions and limits
caveats.unreplayable: Holdings that could not be replayed

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.sub: The same replay under other assumptions.
sensitivity.intro: Three start dates and one threshold variant per rule. Each variant is a full replay, logged with its own id.
sensitivity.tally: Over {n} variants, the series with the strategy ended higher {with} times and the series without rules {without} times (equal: {equal}). Total return gap: from {rMin} to {rMax}; worst fall gap: from {fMin} to {fMax}.
sensitivity.note: A positive worst fall gap means a shallower fall with the strategy. Variants stay in the server's memory during the demo session.

dataset.title: Why this data?
dataset.warningsValue: {count} (on {symbols, plural, one {# symbol} other {# symbols}}), kept and listed in the manifest
dataset.notReplayableValue: {symbols}: a bond yield is not a price
dataset.whyTitle: Why yfinance and a frozen snapshot

why.coverage: Covers the app's whole universe: you can replay your own portfolio, not only an index.
why.sameSource: Same source as the app's live quotes (Yahoo Finance).
why.totalReturn: Total return through the adjusted close: dividends and splits included.
why.reproducible: Reproducible: a new extraction would change past adjusted values, so the snapshot is frozen, checked by SHA-256 and never overwritten.
why.noLookAhead: No look-ahead: only past prices, no current fundamentals; each decision reads only what was known at that day's close.
why.offline: No network call during a replay: the demo depends on no outside service.

dataset.xray: The X-ray applies today's weights to past price changes, without dividends; the time machine follows a strategy through time, with dividends reinvested. The two figures are not comparable.

limitations.unofficial_source: Unofficial source: Yahoo Finance data read with the yfinance library, not certified by the exchanges.
limitations.demo_use_only: Demonstration use only, not commercial: yfinance reads Yahoo data meant for personal and research use.
limitations.survivorship_bias: Survivorship bias: the universe is today's list of large companies, replayed into the past; it looks more favourable than a list picked in 2020 would.
limitations.no_fees_no_taxes: No fees and no taxes by default.
limitations.fx_effect_included: Currency effect included: U.S. assets and crypto are converted to Canadian dollars at the day's USD/CAD rate.
limitations.start_near_market_top: The window starts in December 2020, close to the 2021 market top that preceded the 2022 decline.
limitations.frozen_snapshot: Frozen snapshot: a new extraction would change past adjusted values, so results are only comparable on the same snapshot id.
limitations.not_frozen: Live Yahoo data, not frozen: results may change from one run to the next.

notes.total_return_adj_close: Returns use the adjusted close (Yahoo method: split- and dividend-adjusted, back-adjusted from the extraction date), so dividends are reinvested in the return.
notes.splits_not_reapplied: The close is split-adjusted and the adjusted close is split- and dividend-adjusted; corporate actions are reference only and never re-applied.
notes.common_calendar: The replay calendar is every day on which the TSX or U.S. markets trade in the snapshot; an asset whose market is closed that day keeps its last close.
notes.crypto_previous_utc_day: Crypto rows are UTC days ending at midnight UTC, after the North American close; on a given date the replay uses the crypto close of the previous UTC day.
notes.fx_last_known_rate: U.S. dollar amounts are converted with Yahoo's USD/CAD close (USDCAD=X) of the day, or the last rate known before it.
notes.quality_checks_recorded: Quality checks (missing days, moves over 25%, zero-volume days, incomplete history, unknown currency) are recorded in manifest.json; a symbol failing a hard check is excluded with its reason, nothing is corrected.
